claim: When Regions are healthy again, routing typically starts back to healthy endpoints with traffic dials that are not set to zero in about 30 seconds. Established active connections are not moved: they continue to route to the zero-weight Region until the client or the server resets the connection, or until the client makes a new connection.

evidence.quote: This means that, typically, routing will start back to healthy endpoints with traffic dials that aren't set to zero in about 30 seconds or so.
When recovery occurs, that is, Regions are healthy again, Global Accelerator returns to regular routing behavior.
However, note that established active connections are not moved.
They continue to route to the zero weight Region until the connection is reset by the client or the server, or until the client makes a new connection.
